metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins, shared across machines

plugins.name: adhd-style
plugins.description: ADHD-friendly output style: next action first, numbered steps, state restated each turn, no tangents or filler (adapted from i-have-adhd)

plugins.name: discuss
plugins.description: Read-only design discussion before building: options, trade-offs, failure modes, then a hand-off prompt (/discuss)

plugins.name: optimize-prompt
plugins.description: Rewrites a rough prompt into a Claude Code-optimized prompt grounded in the codebase (/optimize-prompt)

plugins.name: tmux
plugins.description: Tags the tmux pane with the Claude session id (@claude_session) so tmux can fork the session

plugins.name: wsl-notify
plugins.description: WSL2 + Windows Terminal notifications: tab title, bell and toast when Claude needs you, with an optional title flasher
